title: Message/set create: post-commit read failure causes notCreated despite committed message
description: process_create (message.rs:555-561) calls guard.messages().get(&msg_id) after insert_outbound_message commits atomically. If that read fails (SQLite error), the function returns Err(notCreated/serverFail) — the client is told the message was not created. But the transaction already committed: the message IS in the DB with outbox entries and will be delivered. The client may retry, creating a duplicate. Fix: remove the post-commit read; build the response value from the known input parameters (they are already in scope) or accept that the created response can be minimal.
